name: 纳米Work
desc: 360 企业级智能体工作平台
desc_zh: 360 企业级智能体工作平台
solves: A small business wants to give its team AI but has nobody to operate it. Agents run in an isolated cloud sandbox, while your code and data stay on your side.
solves_zh: 小企业想给团队上 AI，又没有运维人手。智能体跑在云端隔离沙箱里，代码和数据留在你这一侧。
best_for: You run a small business, want AI for your team, and don't want to stand up servers.
best_for_zh: 中小企业主想给团队开 AI，不想自己搭服务器。
notes: 面向中小企业主的一体化智能体平台，云端隔离沙箱是其安全设计的核心卖点 来源：https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/a/202607/30/WS6a6b0de4a310986e2b4682eb.html
